statements.t: BB-301 pivotal study design to be finalized in the first calendar quarter of 2027, and the company remains on track to begin the pivotal trial in mid-2027

We are grateful to the patients, families and investigators who have enabled this progress, and we look forward to confirming the pivotal study design in the first calendar quarter of 2027, with the study on track to commence in mid-2027.”

The Company also announced today that it plans to change its existing fiscal year-end from June 30 to December 31 commencing with its first periodic report following the Form 10-Q for the fiscal quarter ended September 30, 2026.

risks.t: unanticipated developments in and risks related to: the success of our plans to develop and potentially commercialize our product candidates
the timing of the completion of preclinical studies and clinical trials
the timing and sufficiency of patient enrollment and dosing in any future clinical trials
the timing of the availability of data from our clinical trials
the timing and outcome of regulatory filings and approvals
the development of novel adeno-associated viral (AAV) vectors
our potential future out-licenses and collaborations
the plans of licensees of our technology
our intellectual property position and the duration of our patent portfolio
the length of time over which we expect our cash and cash equivalents to be sufficient to execute on our business plan
the ability to enroll sufficient numbers of subjects in clinical trials
